title: A pylint stopIteration Runtime Error caused by runpy.run_path()

labels.name: Crash 💥
labels.description: A bug that makes pylint crash

body:

  Is your issue fixed on the preview release?: pip install pylint astroid --pre -U

### Steps to reproduce

1. Install the latest pylint (2.3.1).
2. Write a `run.py` file.
3. Run `pylint run.py`.

The content of `run.py` file:

```python
from runpy import run_path
_STH = run_path('hello.py')
```
